UserProfile.title: UserProfile
UserProfile.description: Stores core information, health goals, and preferences for each user of the HealthSphere application.

id.description: Unique identifier for the UserProfile entity.

username.description: A unique, publicly displayable username chosen by the user.

email.description: The user's email address, used for communication (not for authentication system).

firstName.description: The first name of the user.

lastName.description: The last name of the user.

weightGoalKg.description: The user's target weight in kilograms.

calorieGoal.description: The user's daily target calorie intake.

activityLevel.description: The user's general activity level (e.g., 'sedentary', 'lightly active', 'moderately active', 'very active', 'extra active') used for calorie estimations.

dietaryPreferences.description: A list of dietary preferences (e.g., 'vegetarian', 'vegan', 'gluten-free') for recipe recommendations.

allergies.description: A list of food allergies the user has.

fitnessGoals.description: A list of fitness goals (e.g., 'lose weight', 'gain muscle', 'maintain weight').

languagePreference.description: The user's preferred language for the application (e.g., 'en' for English, 'vi' for Vietnamese).

profilePictureUri.description: URI to the user's profile picture.

createdAt.description: Timestamp indicating when the user profile was created.

updatedAt.description: Timestamp indicating when the user profile was last updated.

WeightLog.title: WeightLog
WeightLog.description: Records a user's weight at a specific point in time, enabling progress tracking and visualization.

id.description: Unique identifier for the WeightLog entry.

userId.description: Reference to the UserProfile who logged this weight. (Relationship: UserProfile 1:N WeightLog)

weightKg.description: The user's weight in kilograms at the time of logging.

logDate.description: The date and time when the weight was logged.

notes.description: Optional notes or comments about the weight log.

ActivityLog.title: ActivityLog
ActivityLog.description: Records physical activities performed by a user, including estimated calorie expenditure, for progress tracking.

id.description: Unique identifier for the ActivityLog entry.

userId.description: Reference to the UserProfile who performed the activity. (Relationship: UserProfile 1:N ActivityLog)

activityType.description: The type or name of the activity (e.g., 'running', 'walking', 'cycling', 'weightlifting', 'yoga').

durationMinutes.description: The duration of the activity in minutes.

caloriesBurned.description: The estimated number of calories burned during the activity.

logDate.description: The date and time when the activity was logged.

intensity.description: The perceived intensity of the activity (e.g., 'low', 'moderate', 'high').

distanceKm.description: The distance covered during the activity in kilometers (optional, for applicable activities).

FoodItem.title: FoodItem
FoodItem.description: Defines a generic food item with its nutritional information per serving, used for meal logging and recipe ingredients.

name.description: The name of the food item (e.g., 'Apple', 'Chicken Breast', 'Oatmeal').

brand.description: The brand name of the food item, if applicable.

servingSizeGram.description: The standard serving size in grams, if applicable for weight-based items.

servingSizeUnit.description: A description of the standard serving unit (e.g., 'g', 'ml', 'item', 'cup').

caloriesPerServing.description: The number of calories per standard serving.

proteinPerServingGram.description: The amount of protein in grams per standard serving.

carbsPerServingGram.description: The amount of carbohydrates in grams per standard serving.

fatsPerServingGram.description: The amount of fats in grams per standard serving.

sugarPerServingGram.description: The amount of sugar in grams per standard serving.

fiberPerServingGram.description: The amount of fiber in grams per standard serving.

sodiumPerServingMilligram.description: The amount of sodium in milligrams per standard serving.

isCustom.description: Indicates if this food item was created by a user (true) or is a predefined item (false).

createdByUserId.description: Reference to the UserProfile who created this custom food item. (Relationship: UserProfile 1:N FoodItem, conditional on isCustom)

MealLog.title: MealLog
MealLog.description: Records a user's specific meal or snack at a given time, aggregating nutritional data from consumed food items.

id.description: Unique identifier for the MealLog entry.

userId.description: Reference to the UserProfile who logged this meal. (Relationship: UserProfile 1:N MealLog)

logDate.description: The date and time when the meal was logged.

totalCalories.description: The aggregated total calories for all food items in this meal.

totalProtein.description: The aggregated total protein for all food items in this meal.

totalCarbs.description: The aggregated total carbohydrates for all food items in this meal.

totalFats.description: The aggregated total fats for all food items in this meal.

imageUri.description: URI to an image of the meal, potentially for AI recognition and logging.

notes.description: Optional notes or comments about the meal.

MealFoodItem.title: MealFoodItem
MealFoodItem.description: Represents a specific quantity of a FoodItem consumed as part of a MealLog.

id.description: Unique identifier for the MealFoodItem entry.

mealLogId.description: Reference to the MealLog this food item belongs to. (Relationship: MealLog 1:N MealFoodItem)

foodItemId.description: Reference to the FoodItem that was consumed. (Relationship: FoodItem 1:N MealFoodItem)

quantity.description: The quantity of the food item consumed (e.g., number of servings, grams, milliliters).

consumedCalories.description: The calculated calories consumed from this specific entry (quantity * caloriesPerServing).

consumedProtein.description: The calculated protein consumed from this specific entry.

consumedCarbs.description: The calculated carbohydrates consumed from this specific entry.

consumedFats.description: The calculated fats consumed from this specific entry.

Recipe.title: Recipe
Recipe.description: Defines a healthy recipe, potentially suggested by AI, with ingredients and instructions.

description.description: A brief description of the recipe.

instructions.description: Detailed instructions on how to prepare the recipe.

prepTimeMinutes.description: The estimated preparation time for the recipe in minutes.

cookTimeMinutes.description: The estimated cooking time for the recipe in minutes.

servings.description: The number of servings the recipe yields.

estimatedCaloriesPerServing.description: The estimated calories per serving of the recipe.

estimatedProteinPerServing.description: The estimated protein in grams per serving of the recipe.

estimatedCarbsPerServing.description: The estimated carbohydrates in grams per serving of the recipe.

estimatedFatsPerServing.description: The estimated fats in grams per serving of the recipe.

imageUri.description: URI to an image of the prepared recipe.

dietaryTags.description: A list of dietary tags applicable to the recipe (e.g., 'vegetarian', 'low-carb', 'high-protein').

createdByUserId.description: Reference to the UserProfile who submitted this recipe, if user-generated. (Relationship: UserProfile 1:N Recipe)

RecipeIngredient.title: RecipeIngredient
RecipeIngredient.description: Links a Recipe to a FoodItem, specifying the quantity and unit required for that ingredient.

id.description: Unique identifier for the RecipeIngredient entry.

recipeId.description: Reference to the Recipe this ingredient belongs to. (Relationship: Recipe 1:N RecipeIngredient)

foodItemId.description: Reference to the FoodItem used as an ingredient. (Relationship: FoodItem 1:N RecipeIngredient)

quantity.description: The numerical quantity of the ingredient (e.g., 1, 0.5, 200).

unit.description: The unit of measurement for the ingredient quantity (e.g., 'cup', 'tsp', 'g', 'ml', 'item').

CommunityPost.title: CommunityPost
CommunityPost.description: Represents a user-generated post in the community forums, allowing users to share and discuss.

userId.description: Reference to the UserProfile who created this post. (Relationship: UserProfile 1:N CommunityPost)

title.description: The title of the community post.

content.description: The main content of the community post.

imageUri.description: URI to an image associated with the post.

createdAt.description: Timestamp indicating when the post was created.

updatedAt.description: Timestamp indicating when the post was last updated.

CommunityComment.title: CommunityComment
CommunityComment.description: Represents a user's comment on a CommunityPost, facilitating interaction and discussion.

postId.description: Reference to the CommunityPost this comment belongs to. (Relationship: CommunityPost 1:N CommunityComment)

userId.description: Reference to the UserProfile who created this comment. (Relationship: UserProfile 1:N CommunityComment)

createdAt.description: Timestamp indicating when the comment was created.

updatedAt.description: Timestamp indicating when the comment was last updated.

definition.description: Stores core information, health goals, and preferences for each user. Access is restricted to the authenticated user matching `{userId}`. Includes denormalized 'id' and 'userId' fields for authorization independence.

params.name: weightLogId

definition.description: Records physical activities performed by a user. Access is restricted to the authenticated user matching `{userId}`. Includes denormalized 'userId' field for authorization independence.

params.name: userId
params.description: The unique identifier of the user who performed this activity.

params.name: activityLogId
params.description: The unique identifier for a specific activity log entry.

params.description: The unique identifier of the user who created this custom food item.

params.name: foodItemId
params.description: The unique identifier for a specific custom food item.

definition.description: Records a user's specific meal or snack. Access is restricted to the authenticated user matching `{userId}`. Includes denormalized 'userId' field for authorization independence.

params.name: userId
params.description: The unique identifier of the user who logged this meal.

params.name: mealLogId
params.description: The unique identifier for a specific meal log entry.

definition.description: Represents a specific quantity of a FoodItem consumed as part of a user's MealLog. Access is restricted to the authenticated user matching `{userId}`. `mealLogId` in path provides context for authorization independence.

params.name: userId
params.description: The unique identifier of the user who owns the parent meal log.

params.name: mealLogId
params.description: The unique identifier of the parent meal log.

params.name: mealFoodItemId
params.description: The unique identifier for a specific food item within a meal log.

definition.description: A collection of AI-suggested or publicly available healthy recipes. Readable by all users. Does not include `createdByUserId` unless it refers to a system/AI user.
Links a global recipe to its ingredients. Readable by all users, following the parent recipe's access rules.

params.name: recipeId
params.description: The unique identifier of the parent global recipe.

params.name: recipeIngredientId
params.description: The unique identifier for a specific ingredient within a recipe.

definition.description: A collection of recipes created or saved by a specific user. Access is restricted to the authenticated user matching `{userId}`. `createdByUserId` will match `{userId}` from the path for authorization independence.

params.name: userId
params.description: The unique identifier of the user who owns this personal recipe.

params.name: recipeId
params.description: The unique identifier for a specific personal recipe.

definition.description: Links a user's personal recipe to its ingredients. Access is restricted to the authenticated user matching `{userId}`, following the parent personal recipe's access rules. `recipeId` in path provides context for authorization independence.

params.name: userId
params.description: The unique identifier of the user who owns the parent personal recipe.

params.name: recipeId
params.description: The unique identifier of the parent personal recipe.

params.name: recipeIngredientId
params.description: The unique identifier for a specific ingredient within a personal recipe.

definition.description: Represents a user-generated post in the community forums. Readable by all users, writable/deletable by the post's owner (`userId` field). The `userId` field is denormalized for authorization independence.

params.name: postId
params.description: The unique identifier for a specific community post.

params.name: postId
params.description: The unique identifier of the parent community post.

params.name: commentId
params.description: The unique identifier for a specific comment.

firestore.reasoning:
The Firestore structure for HealthSphere prioritizes strong data segregation and path-based authorization to adhere to the core design principles, especially Authorization Independence and QAPs. All user-specific and private data (user profiles, weight logs, activity logs, custom food items, meal logs, and personal recipes) are nested under a top-level `/users/{userId}` collection. This strategy ensures that the `userId` (corresponding to `request.auth.uid`) is always part of the document path. This directly allows security rules to check `request.auth.uid == userId` without needing to perform a `get()` operation on a parent document, thus achieving **Authorization Independence**. For instance, `weightLogs` are stored at `/users/{userId}/weightLogs/{weightLogId}`, making it trivial for rules to confirm ownership and permitting atomic operations.

**Structural Segregation** is applied to distinguish between private user data and public/global application data. For example, `FoodItem`s are split into `/globalFoodItems` (predefined, public-read) and `/users/{userId}/customFoodItems` (user-created, private to the user). Similarly, `Recipe`s are divided into `/globalRecipes` (AI-generated or public, read-only for most) and `/users/{userId}/personalRecipes` (user's own creations, private). This ensures that each collection has a homogeneous security posture, simplifying rule sets dramatically.

**QAPs (Rules are not Filters)** are inherently supported by this design. For private user data, any `list` operation by an authenticated user on their specific `/users/{userId}/...` subcollections will automatically scope to their data, meaning no filtering logic is required in the security rules themselves to restrict data visibility. For public collections like `/globalFoodItems`, `/globalRecipes`, `/communityPosts`, and `/communityPosts/{postId}/comments`, all documents are intended to be publicly readable, so `list` operations will return the entire collection, as intended by the QAP principle. Write access for community posts/comments is enforced by checking `request.auth.uid` against the `userId` field *within* the document, not by filtering the list operation.
